liquidation_math.cost_formula: For real UBTC value=(1-d)*oracle value, liquidation revenue per debt repaid is LIF*(1-d). With total costs c per debt unit, break-even d=1-(1+c)/LIF. This is conditional arithmetic, not executable recovery capacity.
liquidation_math.prompt_markdown_budget_formula: For initial LTV b and real-time oracle markdown d, full debt plus bonus fits collateral when d <= 1-b*LIF before costs. This is a static collateral budget, not the liquidation trigger, realized recovery or safety guarantee.
liquidation_math.oracle_blind_caveat: Conditional model only. If a depeg is omitted by the oracle, a previously healthy position may remain non-liquidatable. For a position already unhealthy under that oracle, liquidator economics additionally require q=market/oracle >= (1+c)/LIF. Actual UBTC feed tracking semantics are not inferred from its description.
